// Executes the connect placement probes' exact production PromQL (SIGNALS.md
// §24) against raw synthetic points in the pinned Mimir engine, without adding
// that engine or its dependencies to the Server module.
package connect_move_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/prometheus/prometheus/model/labels"
	"github.com/prometheus/prometheus/promql"
	"github.com/prometheus/prometheus/promql/promqltest"
	"github.com/prometheus/prometheus/util/teststorage"
)

// Writes each case's native vector; expected classes stay in the Server test.
func TestConnectMoveNativeVectors(t *testing.T) {
	requestPath, outputPath := os.Getenv("MONITOR_MOVE_ENGINE_REQUEST"), os.Getenv("MONITOR_MOVE_ENGINE_OUTPUT")
	if requestPath == "" || outputPath == "" {
		t.Fatal("MONITOR_MOVE_ENGINE_REQUEST and MONITOR_MOVE_ENGINE_OUTPUT are required")
	}
	encoded, err := os.ReadFile(requestPath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var request struct {
		Cases []struct {
			Name       string `json:"name"`
			Query      string `json:"query"`
			Evaluation int64  `json:"evaluation"`
			Series     []struct {
				Labels map[string]string `json:"labels"`
				Points []struct {
					Seconds int64   `json:"seconds"`
					Value   float64 `json:"value"`
				} `json:"points"`
			} `json:"series"`
		} `json:"cases"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(encoded, &request); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(request.Cases) == 0 {
		t.Fatal("raw source cases are required")
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	engine := promqltest.NewTestEngine(t, false, 5*time.Minute, 10_000_000)
	responses := map[string]json.RawMessage{}
	for _, c := range request.Cases {
		if c.Query == "" {
			t.Fatalf("%s: the exact query is required", c.Name)
		}
		store := teststorage.New(t)
		appender := store.Appender(ctx)
		for _, series := range c.Series {
			for _, point := range series.Points {
				if _, err := appender.Append(0, labels.FromMap(series.Labels), point.Seconds*1000, point.Value); err != nil {
					t.Fatalf("%s: append raw point: %v", c.Name, err)
				}
			}
		}
		if err := appender.Commit(); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		query, err := engine.NewInstantQuery(ctx, store, promql.NewPrometheusQueryOpts(false, 5*time.Minute), c.Query, time.Unix(c.Evaluation, 0))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: construct exact query: %v", c.Name, err)
		}
		result := query.Exec(ctx)
		vector, err := result.Vector()
		if err != nil || len(result.Warnings) != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("%s: native query failed or returned incomplete evidence: %v %v", c.Name, err, result.Warnings)
		}
		response, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
			"status": "success",
			"data":   map[string]any{"resultType": "vector", "result": vector},
		})
		query.Close()
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if _, exists := responses[c.Name]; exists {
			t.Fatal("duplicate native case")
		}
		responses[c.Name] = response
		if err := store.Close(); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: close native sample storage: %v", c.Name, err)
		}
	}
	encoded, err = json.Marshal(responses)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(outputPath, encoded, 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
